assessmentUnit: Province/territory, assessed for ordinary lawful recreational hand panning, not industrial mining investment.
interpretation: Ratings are editorial assessments from cited evidence, never government ratings or probabilities of finding gold.
unknownPolicy: Use null when evidence is insufficient. Never assign 1 merely because information is missing.
samplingPolicy: Before scoring a jurisdiction, define a reproducible inventory of districts/localities with comparable evidence quality. Record exclusions, current access dates and geographic bias. Do not score from one exceptional mine, a creator video or an unverified hotspot.

goldPotential.label: Documented recreational placer potential
goldPotential.rule: Highest threshold supported by primary evidence; count independently documented placer districts, not individual duplicate reports. An occurrence requires more than anomalous assay data. This measures documented breadth, not expected recovery or profitability.

scale.1: A systematic survey finds trace occurrences only, with no confirmed placer-production district.
scale.2: At least one confirmed placer occurrence, but no district-level historical placer production established.
scale.3: At least one district has documented historical placer production.
scale.4: At least three distinct districts have documented historical placer production.
scale.5: At least three such districts plus recent primary-source confirmation of continuing placer recovery.

goldPotential.withholdIf: Coverage is selective, districts cannot be distinguished, or evidence concerns only lode mining.

publicAccessibility.label: Verified recreational access
publicAccessibility.rule: Evaluate current ordinary hand-panning pathways, independently of gold abundance. An identified locality needs land/tenure, protected status, equipment rules and access conditions checked; general Crown ownership is insufficient.

scale.1: A current authority establishes that the assessed recreational activity is prohibited throughout the defined assessment area.
scale.2: Only separately negotiated titleholder/landowner or individual permit pathways are documented.
scale.3: A general low-impact pathway is documented, but no individually checked public recreational locality.
scale.4: At least one individually checked public panning locality with conditions and a route for verifying tenure.
scale.5: At least three individually checked public panning localities in two or more districts with current conditions and tenure-check resources.

publicAccessibility.withholdIf: Applicable current legal pathway, Indigenous/surface rights or locality restrictions remain unresolved.

beginnerFriendliness.label: Evidence-based visitor practicality
beginnerFriendliness.rule: For each individually verified legal locality, award one point for each independently documented feature: road/trail access without specialist transport; official or established instruction; straightforward permitted hand equipment; published visitor safety/access instructions; nearby ordinary visitor facilities. Jurisdiction score is the rounded median of at least three sites, with range and site list retained. Zero qualifying features yields 1, explicitly labelled a floor.
beginnerFriendliness.withholdIf: Fewer than three representative legal localities have been assessed, or facilities/access are inferred.

typicalGoldSize.label: Reported placer particle size
typicalGoldSize.rule: Record source measurements and ranges before assigning a bin. Use representative placer-grain distributions or a stated typical/dominant size; ore grain dimensions and record nuggets are excluded. Higher means larger, not better or more abundant.
typicalGoldSize.unit: mm, greatest grain dimension; qualitative sources remain qualitative
typicalGoldSize.withholdIf: Only maxima, mesh sizes with unspecified standards, exceptional nuggets, locality anecdotes or insufficient distributions are available. A local description cannot become a province-wide typical value.

overallOpportunity.label: Recreational opportunity
overallOpportunity.rule: Only compute when goldPotential, publicAccessibility and beginnerFriendliness are all scored. Weighted mean: 40% potential + 40% accessibility + 20% beginner friendliness. Round to nearest integer; a halfway value rounds upward. Retain raw score and component citations. Gold size is descriptive and excluded.
overallOpportunity.withholdIf: Any of the three required component scores is null. Do not average away unknowns.

releaseDecision: All Canadian jurisdiction scores remain null in this release: representative recreational site inventories and size distributions have not been established. Industrial production is retained as separate historical evidence.
